purpose: The generation-dependent systematics variations. Each is the nominal tune card with EXACTLY ONE setting changed. Cards are generated from this file by tools/make_systematic_cards.py and are never hand-edited.
ordinal_note: The authoritative burned-seed ledger is /data/alice/ipardoza/Hadronization/config/burned_seeds.txt (untracked and git-ignored, so appending to it does not dirty the frozen checkout). It carried 3557 seeds at ordinals 0 and 3 when these were claimed on 2026-08-17.

variations.name: mur_up
variations.nominal_value: 1. (PYTHIA default; the nominal cards do not set it)
variations.rationale: Factor-two two-point variation, the standard convention for a leading-order calculation.

variations.name: mur_down
variations.nominal_value: 1. (PYTHIA default; the nominal cards do not set it)
variations.rationale: Factor-two two-point variation, the standard convention for a leading-order calculation.

variations.name: muf_up
variations.nominal_value: 1. (PYTHIA default; the nominal cards do not set it)
variations.rationale: Varied independently of the renormalisation scale, not coherently with it, so that S1 and S2 do not entangle: mu_F and the PDF act on the same object, the initial-state parton flux. See the pre-registration S1.

variations.name: muf_down
variations.nominal_value: 1. (PYTHIA default; the nominal cards do not set it)
variations.rationale: Varied independently of the renormalisation scale, not coherently with it, so that S1 and S2 do not entangle: mu_F and the PDF act on the same object, the initial-state parton flux. See the pre-registration S1.

variations.name: pdf_cteq6l1
variations.nominal_value: 13 (NNPDF2.3 QCD+QED LO, alpha_s(M_Z) = 0.130; the PYTHIA default, which Tune:pp = 14 resolves to)
variations.rationale: CTEQ6L1, LO, alpha_s(M_Z) = 0.1298. Chosen because alpha_s is within 0.15% of the nominal, so the variation isolates PDF SHAPE instead of smuggling in an alpha_s change; pSet 14 is the same NNPDF2.3 fit at alpha_s = 0.119 and would double-count the mu_R arm. Different collaboration and fit methodology, and a genuinely used tune baseline. PYTHIA-internal, so no LHAPDF dependency.

variations.name: pthat_1p0
variations.rationale: The scan's own measured point below nominal (results/validation/generator/PTHAT_MULTIPLICITY_SCAN_8317.md): dN_ch/deta 4.973, 28.6% below minimum bias. Not routed through campaign.py's --pthat-min override, which is restricted to role=pilot and to {0.5,1.0,2.0}, so both arms share one code path.

variations.name: pthat_4p0
variations.rationale: The scan's own measured point above nominal: dN_ch/deta 10.492, 50.6% above minimum bias. Outside campaign.py's PTHAT_OVERRIDES, which is one reason both arms go through the generated-card mechanism.
